visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short brown hair and black-framed glasses is the central figure, seen from the waist up against a neutral bathroom background. He wears a black ribbed tank top. He raises his right arm to demonstrate hair removal, using a white cloth to wipe a dark, creamy substance from his armpit, revealing smooth skin underneath. The bathroom setting includes a glass shower wall and a white towel hanging on a rack. (2) The man demonstrates the product's application by holding a white squeeze tube labeled "MMO". He applies a thick white cream directly to his left armpit while his arm is raised behind his head. He uses his right hand to massage and spread the cream across the dark hair. Dynamic text overlays in various colors and sizes flash across his chest area. His facial expressions are expressive, often smiling or looking directly into the camera lens. (3) In the final phase, the man displays both clean armpits, posing with his arms up and holding the "MMO" products. He holds two white tubes and a small rectangular box above his head like ears. He dances playfully, swaying his shoulders and smiling. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the product packaging and his skin texture. The shot remains a medium close-up, focusing on his torso and facial reactions to the results.

The vocal clarity is very high, suggesting a professional microphone or clean studio environment with minimal noise.
